summary_md: **mike andrews ([@algomagic](https://x.com/algomagic/status/2116127259853517228))** points to *From Grind to Grasp* ([arXiv 2610.38728](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38728)), which defines grasp as performance across work budgets, contrasting efficient problem-solving with costly grind and warning about self-sustaining agent collectives.
